premises.text: Robots are constrained by hardware rather than brains, sensors, or software.
premises.evidence_span: As a result, robots are no longer constrained by these parts. They're instead constrained by the hardware.

premises.text: Affordable and accessible quality hardware can increase the pace of innovation in robotics.
premises.evidence_span: if more people can afford and access quality hardware, then the pace of innovation can be massively increased.

premises.text: Modbot provides common building blocks for building various types of robots.
premises.evidence_span: Modbot identifies the common building blocks found in all robots. The servo, the joint, and the link.

premises.text: Modbot allows for rapid prototyping and programming of robots.
premises.evidence_span: you can use our phone app to do hardware programming on the fly, record keyframes, and repeat sequences wirelessly.

premises.text: Modbot's integrated design reduces costs and improves compactness and weight efficiency.
premises.evidence_span: we've managed to reduce the cost of an industrial equivalent by about one-tenth. And it also gets us advantages in compactness and weight efficiency.

premises.text: Modbot enables users to build a wide range of robotic applications easily.
premises.evidence_span: just these three unique parts let you build an amazing array of engineering feats that would have been very difficult otherwise.

premises.text: Modbot aims to democratize robotics by making it accessible to small businesses and individuals.
premises.evidence_span: Small businesses will be able to afford to build entire production lines locally.

value.text: Robotics becomes accessible and affordable for everyday inventors and small businesses.
value.evidence_span: we believe that ModBot can do the same for robots.

notes: No separate premises for crowdfunding campaign as it is a funding mechanism.
